Name: Sephar
ModernLocation: Unknown; candidates include Zafar and Al Baleed
Description: Sephar was a mountain or town named as the eastern limit of the Joktanites' dwelling, from Mesha as far as Sephar, a mount of the east.
BiblicalSignificance: Sephar is a Table of Nations boundary: the eastern edge of Joktan's sons' territory after the Flood.
